events.title: Universal Health Realty Stock Slips Post Q1 Earnings, FFO Rises
events.body: UHT posts higher first-quarter 2026 profit and FFO on lower interest costs, lifts dividend, expands credit line and advances a pre-leased medical office project.

events.title: Universal Health Realty Stock Gains Post Q4 Earnings, Revenue Slips
events.body: UHT posts lower fourth-quarter 2025 earnings and softer revenue, raises dividend and advances new Florida medical office development.
